content: How strange, your first interaction with Light Elemetal was not as you expected.
All those tales of Light winning over the Dark and here you are with an ingot that only seems to refracture light.
No way you're making a sword capable of smiting those zombie hordes with this.
It seems we're dealing with literal light here, maybe it can be used in a different way than you expected initially.
You devised a pair of shears that can cut through the light
These shears are capable of changing the colour of the wool from sheared sheep, but only the white ones.
This first iteration isn't completely reliable, The wool will be of a random colour, but at least you'll save on some dye costs.
